import pytest
from datetime import datetime
from payments.tokenization.schema import validate_tokenize_request, ValidationError

NOW = datetime(2026, 6, 1)

VALID_CARD = {"number": "4242 4242 4242 4242", "exp_month": 12, "exp_year": 2030}


def test_valid_request_normalizes_number():
    out = validate_tokenize_request({"card": VALID_CARD}, now=NOW)
    assert out["card"]["number"] == "4242424242424242"
    assert out["card"]["exp_year"] == 2030


def test_luhn_failure():
    card = dict(VALID_CARD, number="4242424242424241")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as e:
        validate_tokenize_request({"card": card}, now=NOW)
    assert e.value.errors[0]["code"] == "PAN_LUHN_FAILED"
    assert e.value.errors[0]["path"] == "card.number"


def test_pan_never_leaks_in_message():
    card = dict(VALID_CARD, number="4242424242424241")
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as e:
        validate_tokenize_request({"card": card}, now=NOW)
    assert "4242424242424241" not in str(e.value)
    assert "4242424242424241" not in repr(e.value)


def test_expired_card_two_digit_year():
    card = dict(VALID_CARD, exp_month=3, exp_year=26)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as e:
        validate_tokenize_request({"card": card}, now=NOW)
    assert e.value.errors[0]["code"] == "CARD_EXPIRED"


def test_collects_multiple_errors():
    card = {"number": "12", "exp_month": 13, "exp_year": "abc"}
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as e:
        validate_tokenize_request({"card": card}, now=NOW)
    codes = sorted(err["code"] for err in e.value.errors)
    assert codes == ["EXP_MONTH_INVALID", "EXP_YEAR_INVALID", "PAN_LENGTH_INVALID"]


def test_cvc_stripped_from_output():
    card = dict(VALID_CARD, cvc="123")
    out = validate_tokenize_request({"card": card}, now=NOW)
    assert "cvc" not in out["card"]


def test_billing_us_requires_postal_code():
    payload = {"card": VALID_CARD, "billing_address": {"country": "US"}}
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as e:
        validate_tokenize_request(payload, now=NOW)
    assert e.value.errors[0]["code"] == "POSTAL_CODE_REQUIRED"
    assert e.value.errors[0]["path"] == "billing_address.postal_code"


def test_unknown_top_level_field_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as e:
        validate_tokenize_request({"card": VALID_CARD, "extra": 1}, now=NOW)
    assert e.value.errors[0]["code"] == "UNKNOWN_FIELD"
